title: The Upskilling Labs
description: A free community where people learn by building real things together, in person and near you. Find your people. Build your edge.

title: Find your people.
Build your edge.
hero.orbLabel: A living model of The Labs: local Labs orbit the orb, each a network of people, places, projects and knowledge tied together, with a commons of contributors circling the centre. The denser a Lab's ties, the stronger its pull; the densest have formed small orbs of their own. Sparks of new ideas run along the ties, up to the centre and back out to every Lab.

intro.lede: AI is rewriting how we work, and it's easier to learn together than alone. The Upskilling Labs is a free community where you find people near you, build something real, and grow more confident together.
intro.terms: One Upskilling account, whichever path you take.
intro.note: Creates your free Upskilling account, with Google.
intro.$people: The faces are the Inaugural AI Cohort's portraits (OLOS public/assets/cohort-grid-sample.png); the count is the DC Lab's on Sep 29, 2026. In OLOS, both from its members.

facts.title: A new way to learn, together.

items.title: Free, always.
items.body: Workshops and Build Cycles cost nothing.

items.title: Rooted in your library.
items.body: In person at your local Lab, with sessions online too.

items.title: No tech background.
items.body: Just a willingness to learn by doing, alongside others.

items.title: Built in the open.
items.body: Everything we make is open source, free for anyone to use and build on.

how.title: One account. Then build something, and pass it on.

steps.title: Create your account.
steps.body: One free Upskilling account for everything: sign in with Google.

steps.title: Drop into a workshop.
steps.body: Free, hands-on and weekly. Most people start here.

steps.title: Join a Build Cycle.
steps.body: Twelve weeks. Month one: find a problem worth solving, and form a Pod around it.

steps.title: Experiment.
steps.body: Month two: prototype and test your ideas, with peers and Mentors beside you.

steps.title: Show it.
steps.body: Month three: a working prototype and a public showcase. It can keep going as open source.

steps.title: Give back.
steps.body: Mentor, run a Pod, or bring the next person in.

cycle.title: Fall 2026 starts October 13.
cycle.body: Twelve weeks, a group of curious peers, and a problem worth solving. It's an open cycle: the projects are open source, free for anyone to use and build on.

sessions.title: Drop into a session.

learn.title: Durable skills
learn.body: The human skills the future of work runs on: communication, storytelling, and framing problems well.

learn.title: AI skills
learn.body: Working with AI: understanding LLMs, prompting, vibe coding, building agents.

learn.title: In step with the cycle
learn.body: Drop in whenever. Sessions track the Build Cycle, so each one gives your Pod what it needs next.

room.title: Pull up a chair.
room.body: It happens in person, at your library, with people figuring it out alongside you.
room.alt: A Labs evening at the library: people talking in small groups around the tables.

roles.title: Find your role.
roles.lede: Every path starts with your free Upskilling account. Then take a role, or several; each has its own button.

items.quote: I left realizing my gap is exactly where my strength lies—translating between tools, teams, and user needs.

items.title: Founded in DC.
items.body: A pilot at the DC Public Library in the fall of 2025: a small group of 50 former federal workers, navigating career change and new technologies together. Now it's open to every professional.

items.title: Built to scale.
items.body: We run the Build Cycle on ourselves and turn what works into an operating system and playbooks, so a new Lab can start anywhere without reinventing it.

items.title: Expanding nationally.
items.body: From DC to cities across the country, wherever people are ready to learn by doing alongside their neighbors.

join.title: Find your people.
join.lede: The systems we've relied on are breaking. Here, you're invited to turn that disruption into resilience, rooted in your local library and powered by you and your neighbors.
join.note: Creates your free Upskilling account, with Google.
